name: Liu's Cafe
note: The shop's page: "Taiwanese comfort food and Hong Kong-inspired classics", "Michelin Guide Bib Gourmand 2024, 2025 & 2026", "Liu's Cafe comes from our years of eating at comfy Chinese mom-and-pop restaurants". A restaurant (rice plates, noodle soups, a Bib Gourmand); its drinks list is milk tea, lemon tea and oolong. Its own hours, Wed - Sun 11:00am - 9:00pm, agree with OpenStreetMap.
